# Mehfil (महफ़िल)

> Words from models, numbers from code: an intelligent milestone celebration planning workspace where budget, timeline, vendors, and personalized ideas form a single mathematically linked plan in integer paise (INR).

## Core Principles
- **Mathematical Integrity**: Pure code owns all figures and dates. Models are structurally banned from generating monetary amounts or dates.
- **Integer Currency**: All financial figures are stored and apportioned as integer paise (`INR`) using the Hare-Niemeyer largest-remainder algorithm to eliminate floating-point rounding errors.
- **Protected Floors**: A family's single most cherished experience ("Protected Moment") is locked with a hard 40% floor that cannot be eroded by dynamic re-balancing.
- **Quarantined Quote Checking**: Untrusted vendor quotes (PDF/image/text) are parsed in isolated XML sandboxes (`<untrusted_vendor_quote>`) with zero tool execution, two-phase verbatim phrase extraction, and statutory GST / hidden fee omission warnings.
- **Resilient Fallback Ladder**: Three-tier architecture (Gemma 4 -> Gemini 3.5 Flash Lite -> Deterministic Heuristic Engine) guarantees sub-second execution with zero runtime exceptions or blank states.
- **Private Collaboration**: Dual-link capability sharing with unguessable capability edit keys and read-only family view links (negotiations and vendor margins automatically stripped).

## Architecture & Technology Stack
- **Framework**: Next.js 15 (App Router), React 19, TypeScript 5.6+
- **Styling**: Tailwind CSS with custom 3-hue tokens (Warm Ivory `#FFF8EE`, Marigold `#F7C873`, Gulabi Rose `#F2A7B8`, Royal Plum ink `#3A2442`)
- **Animation**: Motion & GSAP with strict reduced-motion adherence
- **AI Providers**: `@ai-sdk/google` (Gemma 4 31B, Gemini 3.5 Flash Lite, and deterministic local heuristics)
- **Database & Auth**: Supabase PostgreSQL with capability tokens, anonymous sessions, and local storage fallback
